description: Basic CircleCI operations - pipeline status, triggering, and context queries

cases.prompt: What is the status of the last pipeline run on the main branch of the luisejroblesci/circleci-cli project?
Trigger a new pipeline on the main branch of luisejroblesci/circleci-cli and tell me its ID.
Find the most recent pipeline for luisejroblesci/circleci-cli and list the workflows and their statuses.
Validate the CircleCI config file at .circleci/config.yml and tell me if there are any errors.
Show me the last 5 builds for luisejroblesci/circleci-cli and highlight any that failed.
